findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (RCS 758)
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading (66 aye, 47 no). Ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) adds new G.S. 163-83: a county board processes a registration only if it affirmatively says the applicant is a US citizen, and a form with no answer gets a 30-day notice and a sworn citizenship statement or the registration is denied. It also has the State Board set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The bill page shows a Governor's veto and a last action of placed on calendar for 09/02/2026.
